notes: The date of the On Peace attack is unresolved: UKMTO warning 156-26 records the projectile strike at 1637 UTC on 5 October, while India and Oman report the attack on 6 October.
The 12 injured and the ship name in the On Peace paragraph came from India's foreign ministry and Oman's defence ministry, not from UKMTO, whose warning named no ship and reported no casualties.

India's reaction sits in the Marshall Islands paragraph but belongs to the Royad Mammadov attack on 5 October, where Firstpost reported three nationals safe, one injured and two foreign nationals dead.
The 5 October attack is already held as INC-20261005-001 with 132 sources, so the survivor INC-20261005-022 can be folded into it.
